chose: Where the cast is a burn-in, it is not hidden over a join's overlap while HOST5 is unmerged: every burn-in, the host among them, is recorded on its own and laid over the joined picture (`burnInRequests`, `planAssembly`), never into a scene's segment, so the crossfade never fades the host with itself. A scene's host gives way on the frame the next scene's starts, and no frame shows two. Hiding it for each join's 400 to 800 ms would make the cast blink out at every card. Where the cast is drawn inside a scene's picture, as a spoken card's still draws it (the stage's CastProvider and Bubble), a crossfade would blend two pictures of it and could show a character twice. So the recorder measures where each spoken card's still draws its cast's bubbles (`[data-speaker]`, `CastLayout`), and two spoken cards' scenes crossfade only where their bubbles stand in the same boxes: the fade then softens which bubble is lit, or who sits in one, and never shows a character twice. Where the boxes differ, or weren't measured, the join is a cut (`castMoves`). Beside a card that draws no cast, the cast fades in or out, one copy. On the stage's sample spoken card every scene's bubbles stand in the same boxes, so all its joins crossfade. A soft join with a steady cast beats a hard cut. Both follow the owner's tiebreaker on #3521: natural, cohesive, lifelike, never jarring. Easing the cast between its two shots across a join stays HOST5's (#3526).
options: Crossfade spoken cards whose measured cast boxes match, cut where they move (chosen)
Leave the host burn-in drawn over the join, one copy at a time (kept for the burn-in)
Hide the host over each join's overlap until HOST5's camera layer lands
Cut every join into or out of a spoken card
Crossfade spoken cards excluding the cast's region from the fade
gray: The issue asked for the host hidden over the join until HOST5 lands, to prevent ghosting; the renderer prevents it for the burn-in another way, and hiding has a visible cost of its own, while a still that draws the cast needs its own answer.
undo: Return false from castMoves in cards-essay.ts to crossfade every spoken-card join, or true to cut them; give each host burn-in a beat at opacity 0 over each join's overlap to hide it instead.
